basic_profile.bio: A 27-year-old music enthusiast from Singapore with a passion for electronic dance music. Works as a software developer by day and spends evenings curating Spotify playlists. Enjoys discovering new tunes and supporting up-and-coming artists. Typically online during late evenings due to work commitments. Single and enjoys spending weekends exploring the local music scene.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Holds a degree in computer science and has been working in the tech industry for over 5 years. Developed an interest in electronic music during college and has been self-teaching music production ever since. Keeps up with the latest trends in both technology and music.
